name: Al Kahfi Mosque Platform
description: A responsive mosque information platform for prayer schedules, daily prayers, hadith collections, and community donations.
overview: Al Kahfi Mosque Platform brings essential worship information into one accessible website, helping the community check prayer times, browse daily prayers, explore hadith collections, and access donation information.
challenge: Worship information was spread across different sources.
Prayer schedules and religious content needed to remain clear and easy to scan.
The experience had to work comfortably across desktop and mobile devices.
solution: Created a focused information architecture for prayer times, prayers, and hadith.
Designed reusable content cards and readable data layouts.
Built responsive interfaces with clear navigation between key mosque services.
outcome: Centralized essential mosque information in one digital platform.
Made prayer schedules and religious content easier to access.
Delivered a consistent interface for the Al Kahfi community.

name: Mobile Booking Application
description: A cross-platform mobile booking flow with clear navigation, real-time updates, and smooth user interactions across devices.
overview: Mobile Booking Application is a cross-platform product focused on helping users discover services, book available time slots, and track booking status in a simple mobile flow.
challenge: Booking flows can lose users when steps feel unclear.
Availability, confirmation, and status updates had to be easy to understand.
The experience needed to stay smooth on smaller mobile screens.
solution: Created a focused mobile flow for service selection and scheduling.
Structured reusable booking states for pending, confirmed, and updated appointments.
Planned Firebase and REST API integration for real-time availability.
outcome: Delivered a cleaner booking journey with predictable navigation.
Reduced friction across the main appointment flow.
Prepared the app structure for production feature expansion.

name: Learning Management System
description: A streamlined LMS experience for course delivery, student progress tracking, and academic operations with a clean responsive interface.
overview: Learning Management System is a web platform concept for managing courses, student progress, learning materials, and academic operations from one responsive interface.
challenge: Students and administrators needed different workflows in one platform.
Course, progress, and content screens had to feel connected.
The interface needed to avoid overwhelming users with too many actions.
solution: Planned a clear information architecture for courses and learning progress.
Created role-aware UI patterns for student and admin experiences.
Used typed frontend structure with Supabase-ready data planning.
outcome: Created a scalable LMS concept for academic workflows.
Improved clarity across course delivery and progress tracking.
Kept the interface responsive and easier to maintain.

name: Clinic Appointment Portal
description: A healthcare scheduling system for appointment booking, doctor availability management, and patient communication with a calm service-first interface.
overview: Clinic Appointment Portal is a scheduling system concept for clinics that need to manage appointments, doctor availability, and patient communication in one calm interface.
challenge: Healthcare scheduling must feel clear and trustworthy.
Staff needed quick access to appointments, patients, and doctor availability.
The booking flow had to avoid unnecessary complexity.
solution: Structured the portal around appointment states and schedule views.
Designed patient and doctor information to be easy to scan.
Planned a Node.js and PostgreSQL-ready architecture for operational data.
outcome: Created a practical workflow for clinic appointment coordination.
Improved clarity for staff managing daily schedules.
Kept the patient-facing flow simple and service-focused.

name: Apple Health Companion
description: A connected iOS product concept that syncs health insights, daily activity summaries, and wearable data into a focused Apple ecosystem experience.
overview: Apple Health Companion is an iOS product concept that presents health insights, daily activity summaries, and wearable data in a focused Apple ecosystem experience.
challenge: Health data can become noisy when too many metrics appear at once.
Users needed quick daily insights instead of dense reports.
The interface had to feel calm, readable, and mobile-native.
solution: Designed focused summary cards for daily activity and health signals.
Planned HealthKit integration around meaningful user-facing insights.
Used lightweight hierarchy aligned with native iOS interaction patterns.
outcome: Made connected health information easier to understand.
Reduced cognitive load through focused daily summaries.
Created a cleaner foundation for a native iOS health companion.
